meta.title: Inzira — inyandiko za leta, zigukorerwa bitakugoye
meta.description: Ubufasha bw'umwuga butari bwa leta mu Rwanda mu kwandikisha ubucuruzi muri RDB, imisoro, EBM, serivisi z'ubutaka, ibyangombwa bya RURA by'ibinyabiziga na Irembo. Si urubuga rwa leta.
meta.servicesDescription: Kwandikisha ubucuruzi, imisoro, EBM, ubutaka, serivisi za RURA n'iza Irembo mu Rwanda — amafaranga y'urwego n'amafaranga ya Inzira yo gufasha bigaragara ukwabyo.
meta.trackDescription: Reba aho ubusabe bwawe muri Inzira bugeze ukoresheje nomero yabwo na nomero yawe ya telefoni.

footer.blurb: Inyandiko za leta ku bucuruzi n'abanyamwuga mu Rwanda, zirasuzumwa, zikoherezwa kandi zigakurikiranwa ku bwawe.
footer.disclaimer: Inzira ni sosiyete yigenga itanga ubufasha bw'umwuga. Ntabwo turi Irembo, RRA, RDB, RURA, ubuyobozi bw'ubutaka cyangwa urundi rwego urwo ari rwo rwose rwa leta, kandi ntidutanga inama z'amategeko. Amafaranga y'urwego n'imisoro bishyirwaho kandi bigakusanywa n'urwego rubifitiye ububasha; amafaranga ya Inzira yo gufasha ari ukwayo kandi agaragazwa ku murongo wayo wihariye buri gihe.

contact.waPrefill: Muraho Inzira, nkeneye ubufasha ku busabe bwanjye.

home.deletedBody: Imyirondoro yawe n'inyandiko zawe byasibwe. Amakuru y'ubwishyu yagumyeho ariko nta zina cyangwa nomero yawe birimo.
home.lead: Kwandikisha sosiyete, imisoro, EBM, ibyangombwa by'ubutaka n'uruhushya rwa RURA ku bucuruzi mu Rwanda. Dusuzuma inyandiko zawe, tukazohereza ku nzego zibifitiye ububasha kandi tugakurikiranira hafi kugeza bikozwe.
home.caseLabel: Urugero: ubusabe bwo kwandikisha sosiyete muri RDB
home.step2m: Ku wa mbere, 14:30. Zose uko ari 3 zaremewe
home.step4m: Gitegerejwe mu minsi 1 kugeza kuri 2 y'akazi
home.filedNote: Ikigo cyigenga. Ntabwo kiri muri izi nzego cyangwa ngo kibe kiyoborwa na zo.
home.feesLead: Amafaranga yacu kuri buri serivisi aragenwe kandi twumvikanaho mbere y'uko dutangira.
home.feesNote: Amafaranga y'urwego ashyirwaho n'urwego rubifitiye ububasha kandi agaragazwa kuri buri serivisi mbere yo kwishyura. Akenshi uyishyurira urwego ubwarwo mu buryo butaziguye, inyemezabwishyu ikaza mu izina ryawe. Nta kirenga kigirwaho iyo anyuze muri Inzira.
home.notListed: Serivisi nkeneye ntabwo iri ku rutonde
home.howLead: Intambwe enye zoroshye, kandi iya mbere gusa niyo igusaba kugira icyo ukora. Umukozi umwe agufasha kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku musozo.
home.s1d: Hitamo serivisi, cyangwa usobanure ibyo ukeneye mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza cyangwa Igifaransa. Kubaza ni ubuntu.
home.s2d: Tukumenyesha neza inyandiko ibura mbere y'uko ubusabe bwoherezwa. Aha ni ho haturuka kenshi kudasubizwa neza.
home.s3d: Bikorerwa ku rubuga rw'urwego rubifitiye ububasha. Uhabwa nomero y'ubusabe, kandi twihutisha ubusabe bwatinze.
home.s4d: Icyangombwa n'inyemezabwishyu byoherezwa muri konti yawe no kuri WhatsApp.
home.a1: {legal} ni sosiyete yigenga yo mu Rwanda ikorera i {city}. Ikipe yacu itegura, igasaba kandi igakurikiranira hafi dosiye z'inzego za leta ku bacuruzi n'abanyamwuga bahitamo gukoresha igihe cyabo mu mirimo yabo. Ibi ushobora kubyikorera wowe ubwawe; twe tugukuriraho imirongo yo gutegereza, kuzuza fomu no gukurikiranira hafi.
home.q2: Muri abakozi ba leta cyangwa ba Irembo?
home.a2: Oya. Inzira ni ikigo cyigenga. Dukoresha imiyoboro y'inzego za leta ku bwawe: Irembo, RRA, RDB, RURA n'izindi. Buri mwanzuro ufatwa n'urwego rubifitiye ububasha ubwarwo.
home.a3: Amafaranga y'urwego cyangwa umusoro ajya ku rwego rwa leta, nk'uko rwabigennye, kandi akenshi urwishyurira ubwawe mu buryo butaziguye. Amafaranga yacu ashyirwa ku gusuzuma, gutegura, kohereza ubusabe no kubukurikiranira hafi. Yombi uyabona mbere yo kwishyura.
home.q4: Mushobora kwizeza 100% ko ubusabe bwanjye bwemerwa?
home.a4: Ntawe ushobora kubyizeza; urwego rwa leta nirwo rwonyine rufata umwanzuro. Icyo dukora ni ukumenya neza ko dosiye yawe yuzuye kandi itunganye mbere yo kuyohereza, tukayikurikirana kugeza ikozwe.
home.q5: Bigenze bite se niba serivisi nkeneye itari ku rutonde?
home.a5: Tubwire icyo ukeneye. Kenshi dufasha mu zindi serivisi zo kuri interineti, kandi twumvikana ku mikorere n'amafaranga yacu mbere yo gutangira.
home.closeLead: Tubwire icyo ukeneye kuri WhatsApp, kuri telefoni cyangwa kuri imeyili. Turakubwira uko bikorwa, inyandiko zikenewe n'amafaranga yose uko yakabaye, ku buntu kandi mbere yo gufata umwanzuro.
